description: What a US mutual fund or ETF holds, from its own SEC Form N-PORT (VOO, IVV, QQQ, AGG, FXAIX): every position with value and weight, exposure by asset type, issuer, country and currency, a bond fund's coupon and maturity profile, its monthly returns, the money that came in and went out each month, and what changed since the previous quarter.

compare.description: Also compare with the previous public report; default true.

fund.description: A mutual fund or ETF ticker (VOO, IVV, QQQ, AGG, FXAIX, ARKK) or an SEC series id (S000004310).

period.description: Report date, the last day of a fiscal quarter's last month (2026-06-30); default the latest public one.

top.description: Most positions to list, by value; default 25.

name: fund_portfolio

outputSchema.description: rows are the largest positions by value, weights as fractions of net assets; exposure sums weights by asset type, issuer, country and currency; flows are dollars in and out each month.

title: Fund or ETF portfolio (N-PORT)
